# Built-in fonts

`Roboto-Regular.ttf` (Roboto 1.00000, 2011, Apache License 2.0 - see `LICENSE.txt`) is embedded into the
engine at build time (CMake turns it into `build/.../EmbeddedFonts.cpp`) and is the UI font named `default`.
